import json,sys,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from ground_truth_studio.integrity_service import sha256
out=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/final_bbox_20261116_57d1b826'
rows=json.loads((out/'annotation_lineage_manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['rows']
subset=json.loads((out/'clean_vn_manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
groups=defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:groups[r['source_video_sha256']].append(r)
sourcegroups=[{'source_video_sha256':key,'video_ids':sorted({r['source_video_id'] for r in members}),
 'source_paths':sorted({r['source_video_path'] for r in members}),
 'reservations':dict(Counter(r['split'] for r in members)),'images':len(members),
 'camera_id':None,'scene_group_id':None,'scene_status':'UNKNOWN_NOT_INDEPENDENT'} for key,members in sorted(groups.items())]
shortlist=[{'source_pair':pair,'reviewed_verified_impact':sum(sum(r['lineage_verified'] and r['human_approved'] for r in groups[s]) for s in pair),
 'sources':[next(g for g in sourcegroups if g['source_video_sha256']==s) for s in pair],
 'status':'UNRESOLVED','required_evidence':'Source/camera/scene evidence with reviewer/time/member hashes; not perceptual similarity alone'} for pair in subset['unresolved_source_pairs']]
shortlist.sort(key=lambda r:(-r['reviewed_verified_impact'],r['source_pair']))
for name,value in [('source_groups.json',sourcegroups),('human_source_shortlist_final.json',shortlist)]:
 with (out/name).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(value,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
protocol=json.loads((root/'configs/research/week5_execution_protocol_v2.json').read_text())
assert sha256(root/protocol['checkpoint'])==protocol['checkpoint_sha256']
new=json.loads((out/'new_baseline_protocol.json').read_text());assert sha256(root/new['initialization_path'])==new['initialization_sha256']
with (out/'baseline_recheck.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump({'old_checkpoint_sha256':protocol['checkpoint_sha256'],
 'class_mapping':protocol['class_mapping'],'membership_status':'BASELINE_MEMBERSHIP_NOT_VERIFIED',
 'new_initialization_sha256':new['initialization_sha256'],'training_executed':False},f,indent=2)
print({'source_groups':len(sourcegroups),'opposing_unknown_pairs':len(shortlist),'cross_split_same_source_groups':sum(len(g['reservations'])>1 for g in sourcegroups)})

import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from ground_truth_studio.bbox_service import load_queue,QUEUE
from ground_truth_studio.integrity_service import sha256
out=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/final_bbox_20261116_57d1b826'
parent=out/'annotation_lineage_manifest.json';data=json.loads(parent.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
queue={r['image_sha256']:r for r in load_queue(root)}
for row in data['rows']:
 q=queue[row['image_sha256']]
 row.update(original_label_path=q['label_path'],original_label_sha256=q['label_sha256'],
            original_aliases=q['aliases'],parent_annotation_lineage_sha256=sha256(parent),
            eligible_for_training=False,eligible_for_validation=False,eligible_for_test=False,
            exclusion_reasons=['SCENE_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED']+
              ([] if row['lineage_verified'] else ['LINEAGE_NOT_VERIFIED'])+
              ([] if row['human_approved'] else ['HUMAN_REJECTED'])+
              (['RESERVED_TEST'] if row['split']=='test' else [])+
              (['SOURCE_CORRUPTED'] if row['source_video_id']=='VN_NEG_10' else []))
data.update(parent_annotation_lineage_sha256=sha256(parent),
 parent_queue_sha256={name:sha256(root/QUEUE/name) for name in ['bbox_annotation_queue.csv','empty_label_review_129.csv']},
 reserved_test_not_selected=True,hard_negative_semantic_tags='UNKNOWN_UNLESS_HUMAN_VERIFIED; negative attestation alone is not welding/context tag')
with (out/'candidate_provenance_manifest.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(data,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
print(len(data['rows']))

import json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];local=Path(__file__).parent
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',YOLO_AUTOINSTALL='false',PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8')
env['PATH']=str(root/'.tools/ffmpeg')+os.pathsep+env['PATH']
report=root/'docs/multicamera_rtsp_benchmark_report.md';before=report.read_bytes();results=[]
commands=[('targeted',[sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_bbox_final_audit.py','tests/test_annotation_policy.py','tests/test_scene_subset.py','tests/test_domain_adaptation.py','tests/test_bbox_resolution.py','tests/test_bbox_integrity_recovery.py','tests/test_week5_readiness.py','tests/test_bbox_qa.py','tests/test_gt_studio_ui.py']),('full',[sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests'])]
try:
 for name,command in commands:
  log=local/(name+'.log');start=time.perf_counter()
  with log.open('w',encoding='utf-8') as stream:r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  results.append({'name':name,'command':command,'exit_code':r.returncode,'duration_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'log':log.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'tail':log.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').splitlines()[-2:]})
  (local/'tests.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(results[-1]),flush=True)
finally:report.write_bytes(before)
sys.exit(0 if all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in results) else 1)
